verdict.rationale: Zep documents thread summaries as natural-language summaries of a thread's messages that Zep generates and updates incrementally. With scope="auto", it folds thread summaries into a single ready-to-use context block, and that block can be returned directly on thread.add_messages, letting an agent resume with prior conversation context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an API to fetch a specific past thread's summary, detail on how summaries carry across separate sessions, and independent hands-on corroboration (the only community mention comes from the Zep creator).

support.subject: As a developer, I can get summaries of past sessions or threads so an agent can pick up where the last conversation left off

citations.quote: A thread summary is a natural-language summary of the messages in a single thread, generated and incrementally updated by Zep.
set scope="auto" and let Zep dynamically compose the most relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block.
Zep will perform a user graph search right after persisting the data and return the context relevant to the recently added messages.
